title: Compat API v1.46: DriverOpts sysctls and image create events
body:
Docker Engine API [v1.46](https://docs.docker.com/reference/api/engine/version-history/#v146-api-changes) still has two Compat gaps before we can treat 1.46 as covered under the parent epic (claim v1.55).
## Needs work
### 1. Per-interface sysctls via `DriverOpts`
- Honor `NetworkingConfig.EndpointsConfig.DriverOpts` on `POST /containers/create` and `EndpointsConfig.DriverOpts` on `POST /networks/{id}/connect`.
- Support label `com.docker.network.endpoint.sysctls`: comma-separated `sysctl=value` list; interface name in the key must be `IFNAME` (e.g. `net.ipv4.config.IFNAME.log_martians=1`).
- Today Compat create/connect ignore `DriverOpts` entirely.
- Related 1.48 note: top-level HostConfig sysctls for `eth0` are no longer migrated into `DriverOpts`; once DriverOpts works, do not reintroduce that migration.
## Checklist
- [ ] `DriverOpts` / `com.docker.network.endpoint.sysctls` on create + connect
## Contributing
If you want to work on one checklist item, please open a focused issue (or PR) for that part and reference **this** issue (and the parent epic). Prefer one change area per PR so DriverOpts and image `create` events can land independently.
## References
